svg.text: Every claim comes with its evidence.

text.tspan: The fault chain is drawn like a schematic: likely cause, mechanism, fault. Each link names the
measurement and key frame it rests on, and how sure the app is about it.

svg.text: M-01 · hips toward the ball, address → impact

tspan.tspan: M-02 · lead hip turn at impact

text.tspan: “The likely cause is restricted hip rotation: at impact your lead hip
had turned 31°, where about 45° is typical, so the hips slide forward
because they cannot turn. It may feel like you stay down, but at
impact your hips have moved toward the ball.”

svg.text: Written only from this analysis. 128 of 150 words.
Fig. 1 (a) key frames with body lines (b) measurement against threshold, with error bar (c) fault chain (d) evidence and confidence band per link (e) coach-voice explanation
It would rather say less than guess.

text.tspan: Three outcomes most swing apps never show you. Each one is a feature, not an error state.
No faults are reported from this clip.
Here is what to change before you film again.

Whole body and club in frame

text.tspan: Weight appears to move toward the trail

svg.text: not in the rule table · no drill

text.tspan: Clips under 120 fps never get high.
Over the top is capped at medium.
The whole method fits on a phone at the range. Three steps, in this order.
Phone on a tripod behind your hands, at hand
height, 2.4–3.7 m away. Whole body and club in
frame. 120 fps or higher if your phone has it.
mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds, one swing per
clip. Choose whether to keep it in your swing
library; if not, it is deleted after analysis.
Pose, swing events, measurements, then the
rule table decides. The coach voice explains
only what the rule table found.
The MVP checks three faults seen down the line. Anything outside this table is labelled unverified.

svg.text: Thresholds are starting values, tuned on a labelled tuning set of swing clips. They are not norms, and the table can change.
Bring one swing. Get the working.

text.tspan: Create an account with email and password. Your clips stay private and are deleted after analysis
unless you choose to save them to your swing library.
